gloss: middle school student, junior high school student

definitions.gloss: middle school student, junior high school student
definitions.explanation: A student attending 中学校, which covers grades 7-9 (ages 12-15) in the Japanese education system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}です。
examples.english: My daughter is a middle school student.

examples.japanese: {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was in middle school, I played tennis in my school club.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧です。
examples.english: This movie has content that even a middle school student can understand.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧ (middle school, abbreviation of ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧) + {生|せい} (student). The suffix ～{生|せい} is used for students at all levels: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧ (elementary), ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧ (high school), ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧ (university).

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
- ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧ — elementary school (6 years, ages 6-12)
- ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ — middle school (3 years, ages 12-15)
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧ — high school (3 years, ages 15-18)

{中学生|ちゅうがくせい} is often abbreviated to ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧ in casual speech: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき (when I was in middle school).
